🚀 ORBITRONIX | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

We are ORBITRONIX,a passionate team exploring technology, space, and real-world problem-solving using NASA’s open data. We welcome creative thinkers, developers, and enthusiastic learners who want to innovate and collaborate. We are looking for skills in AI/ML, Python, web development, data science, UI/UX design, scientific research, and presentation. Join us to turn ideas into impactful solutions!

🌍 Dream × Explore × Create.
